newsitem.title: USA: Voice sets reverse split to avoid delisting.
newsitem.headline: Voice sets reverse split to avoid delisting.

text.p: Voice Powered Technology International Inc said the National Association of Securities Dealers has advised it that its shares may face delisting on the NASDAQ Small Cap system.
The company said it has until February 26 to meet listing requirements or submit a proposal for achieving compliance.

The company said it has a proposal which includes a reverse stock split that should raise its shares above the NASD minimum requirement of $1 a share, assuming that commitments for financing can be obtained before the deadline.
The company designs and develops voice recognition consumer products.
In December it announced a plan to merge with Voice It Worldwide Inc.
